name.baseName: Methanol, from synthetic gas, at plant

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Data from 1995 to 2004, pilot scale, future technology

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Data from few literature sources, largely based on methanol from natural gas.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Data refers to full-methanol steam reforming (as opposed to autothermal reforming) of syngas derived from biomass gasification.

# Included processes
Raw materials including syngas, processing energy, estimate on catalyst use based on "methanol from natural gas", emissions to air and water from process, plant infrastructure.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Production assessed with mixed data from literature and the ecoinvent 'methanol from natural gas' process. Data is considered relatively weak, as there is no commercial experience of methanol from bio-syngas. Representativity of the data seems difficult to assess.

review.common:reviewDetails: Proof reading validation: Passed.; Other validation: none;

publicationAndOwnership.common:accessRestrictions: All information can be accessed by everybody.
